#### KITEBOARD CENTER

**First kiteboarding school in the Riviera Maya. Since 2002.****Professional, experienced, and certified instructors. Lessons available in English, Spanish, German, Italian, and French.**

**· Wide range and size of kitesurf and wingfoil equipment for any wind condition and rider weight.**  
**· All lessons are supported by rescue boats. When needed, students and instructors are taken upwind by jet ski or boat, allowing more time for actual practice. (You learn 30–50% faster than in deep or wavy waters!)**  
**· We teach all ages, as long as students can swim.**  
**· We can train you from beginner level to very advanced tricks.**  
**· We have boards for kiteboard, kitesurf, kitefoil, wingfoil, and wing SUP.**  
**· We create custom packages for Groups and Families. Request a quote.**

**Fantastic place to have fun kitesurfing and relax!** I spent one week at Ikarus to learn kitesurfing as a beginner. It was a blast! Kitesurfing: Both the natural conditions and the crew were perfect to learn. My instructor was Enrique, a fantastic guy and teacher. They efficiently teach you how to set up and take care of the equipment, and it's time to go in the water. From there it was super fun to learn and progress. The water is shallow in the entire lagoon, so when falling, you just get up, control your kite and board, and go again! The place: It's not a 5 star hotel with everything you'd find in the US. It's a little piece of quiet paradise. The rooms are simple, clean, and convenient. There are also options to camp. Everyone was super welcoming and nice. I went solo, but ended up seating with fellow visitors or even the family owning the place almost every meal. So I would alternate the days between a few hours of kitesurfing, reading a book, eating, or chatting with a drink. Perfect vacation to have fun and relax.

#### KITE LESSONS IN ISLA BLANCA - CANCUN

**Kitesurf School Cancun**  
We teach in the lagoon of Isla Blanca one of the best kitesurfing spots in the world for beginners. The water is flat and shallow, making the learning process faster and more efficient. We can work with any wind direction. We teach all levels from beginner to highly advanced including strapless, foil, surfboard, and freestyle. We also offer Wingfoil and Wing SUP lessons. Classes are available on all windy days.

**Our instructors are certified, experienced, and highly qualified. They will make your kitesurfing course an unforgettable experience.**

All lessons are supported by boats. When necessary, students and instructors are taken upwind, allowing for more time to practice. Learning with us and under these ideal conditions is 30–50% faster than in other locations.

**All kitesurf lessons in Cancun are supervised and assisted by a jet ski.**

**Lesson prices include all kitesurf or wingfoil equipment, insurance, and support with a boat or jet ski.**

**· Large gamme d’équipements de kitesurf et de wingfoil, adaptés à toutes les conditions de vent et à tous les gabarits.**  
**· Tous les cours sont accompagnés de bateaux de sécurité. Lorsque nécessaire, les élèves et les instructeurs sont emmenés au vent en jet-ski ou en bateau, ce qui permet de consacrer plus de temps à la pratique réelle. **· Nous enseignons à tous les âges, tant que les élèves savent nager.**

**· Nous disposons de planches pour kiteboard, kitesurf, kitefoil, wingfoil et wing SUP.**  
**· Nous créons des forfaits personnalisés pour les groupes et les familles. Demandez un devis.**

**Fantastic place to have fun kitesurfing and relax!** I spent one week at Ikarus to learn kitesurfing as a beginner. It was a blast! Kitesurfing: Both the natural conditions and the crew were perfect to learn. My instructor was Enrique, a fantastic guy and teacher. They efficiently teach you how to set up and take care of the equipment, and it's time to go in the water. From there it was super fun to learn and progress. The water is shallow in the entire lagoon, so when falling, you just get up, control your kite and board, and go again! The place: It's not a 5 star hotel with everything you'd find in the US. It's a little piece of quiet paradise. The rooms are simple, clean, and convenient. There are also options to camp. Everyone was super welcoming and nice. I went solo, but ended up seating with fellow visitors or even the family owning the place almost every meal. So I would alternate the days between a few hours of kitesurfing, reading a book, eating, or chatting with a drink. Perfect vacation to have fun and relax.
